title: Ucchattar Madhyamik Buranji (উচ্চতৰ মাধ্যমিক বুৰঞ্জী)
author: Dr. Ramesh Chandra Kalita (ড° ৰমেশ চন্দ্ৰ কলিতা)
description: Comprehensive historical treatise and curriculum on the political, economic, and administrative history of Assam and Northeast India. It provides systematic chapters on the Tai-Ahom administrative structure (Paik system, Barbarua, Barphukan), royal chronicle preservation, and the distinct Tai Khamyang, Phake, and Khamti migrations across the Patkai.
source: Guwahati: Assam Higher Secondary Education Council & Students' Stores, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.452037
